notes.title: Updated the game and demo to version 1.2
notes.notes:
I've updated the game and demo to include some suggestions made by the community, and to fix some minor issues with the game.

[list]
[*] Added functionality for the cursor to turn green when you are aiming at an item that you can interact with to help players figure out which items are potential clues, and which are just background.

[*] Fixed the Field of View slider in the Options so that you can now adjust the Field of View to your liking. Note, that you need to have started the game for the change to take effect.

[*] Adjusted the Journal entry headlines so they don't overlap with the associated content, and adjusted the spacing of the content so that it doesn't fall off the edge of the page.

[*] Various tweaks and adjustments to game code that isn't really obvious when you're playing, but none the less had to be adjusted so that the above fixes could work. 
[/list]

notes.title: Overhauling the game for version 0.2
notes.notes:
Currently working on a complete overhaul of the game for version 0.2's release:
[list]
    [*]Removing pure dynamic lighting for increased FPS
    [*]Implementing a new interaction system for better inspection of clues
    [*]Implementing a new branching dialogue system
    [*]Revamping the first mission so it makes more sense
    [*]Adding in a 3rd mission that is longer than the first two combined
    [*]Adding a "detective intuition" meter so you can better gauge how many clues remain
    [*]Adding a Notebook so you can see mission objectives and track progress
[/list]

notes.title: Graphics and Performance update 01C coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]http://apeirogon-games.com/screens/Silhouette_Release01C_Screen01.jpg[/img]

A brand new graphics and performance update is on its way (hopefully before the end of december). On my testing system (GTX 780) I've had a [b]140% - 260% performance increase![/b] The game never drops below 50FPS.
I've also added cel shading and inked outlines to the game which really helps to make it look more unique and comic book like.

After the graphics and performance update, I'm also re-working Mission Zero to make finding the clues more interesting and less of a "screen hunt". This will include a lock picking mini-game for some objects like filing cabinets and other gameplay tweaks and additions. The update for Mission Zero should be available in January.

notes.title: Bug fix 0.1B has arrived!
notes.notes:
Version 01.B is now available and should automatically download when you launch Steam. If you don't see the update, restart Steam and it will be available.

Fixes:

 - Fixed 99.9% of all audio overlaps (there's the occasional rare case where it could technically still happen but I didn't experience any myself).

- Added a pause between being able to interact with objects while the dialogue audio finishes playing.

- Added new cursor/crosshair indication for when you cannot interact with objects due to dialogue length. Cursor/crosshair changes to red while interaction is disabled.

-Added proper eyes to the living characters due to overwhelming requests/comments on the subject

- Fixed the dialogue tree displaying "blank" choices that actually make selections when you press them

- Other small tweaks relating to the audio

- Possibly some other things that I can't remember anymore.
